run_qrdqn_atari_training: run the QR-DQN agent training loop on an Atari environment like Pong with configurable hyperparameters
create_atari_environment: create a GymAtari environment wrapped with random noops for the specified Atari game
build_qr_atari_network: build a quantile regression Atari network with Haiku for distributional reinforcement learning
configure_replay_buffer: configure a TransitionReplay buffer with optional state compression for experience replay
evaluate_epsilon_greedy_actor: evaluate a trained QR-DQN agent using an EpsilonGreedyActor with a fixed exploration rate
